mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_conversion WHERE conversion_no = #{conversionNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_conversion WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_conversion WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_conversion SET status = 'COMPLETED', audited_at = #{auditedAt}, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{auditor} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE inventory_conversion SET status = 'REJECTED', audited_at = #{auditedAt}, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{auditor} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE inventory_conversion SET warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, convert_type = #{convertType}, reason = #{reason}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.conversion_no, t.warehouse_id, t.convert_type, t.status, t.reason, t.remark, t.audited_at, t.auditor, t.audit_opinion, t.version, t.created_at, t.updated_at, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM inventory_conversion t LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = t.warehouse_id WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.id = #{id}
